sections.section_title: The Strong Angel Descends with the Open Scroll
sections.summary: A strong angel descends from heaven bearing divine theophanic attributes (cloud, rainbow, sun-face, fire-pillar feet) and holding an already-opened small scroll, planting his feet on sea and land to signal comprehensive divine authority over the created order.

sections.section_title: The Lion-Roar, the Seven Thunders, and the Sealed Words
sections.summary: The angel cries out like a roaring lion, the seven thunders speak intelligible content, and John is commanded by a heavenly voice to seal what the thunders said and not write it, establishing a boundary on the scope of the written revelation.

sections.section_title: The Angel's Oath -- No More Delay, the Mystery Finished
sections.summary: The angel swears by the eternal Creator that there will be no more delay and that the mystery of God will be completed when the seventh trumpet sounds, directly answering the martyrs' cry of 6:10 and declaring the fulfillment of what God announced to the prophets.

sections.section_title: John Eats the Scroll -- Sweet and Bitter
sections.summary: John is commanded by a heavenly voice to take the open scroll from the angel and eat it, replicating Ezekiel's prophetic commissioning; the scroll is sweet as honey in his mouth but bitter in his stomach, representing the gift of God's word and the devastating weight of its content.

John is re-commissioned under divine compulsion to prophesy again concerning all peoples, nations, languages, and kings, pivoting the document from its first major movement (chapters 1-9) to its second (chapters 11-22) with universal and political scope.
